note: Job sources a plain script may poll. Verified against the research in the plans repository (research/job-boards.md, 2026-10-29); verified_on null means the endpoint shape is documented but was not reached from this environment. rate_limit_minutes is the minimum interval between polls of one subscription. Refused families are listed so the refusal explains itself.

greenhouse.terms: public job board API, no auth, no published limit

smartrecruiters.terms: public postings list; descriptions fetched per posting

workable.terms: widget API; shape documented, not probed

remotive.terms: at most 4 requests per day; 24 h delay; link back to the posting

arbeitnow.terms: public, paginated, filtered locally by the subscription query

usajobs.terms: free key; Authorization-Key and User-Agent (your email) headers
usajobs.example: USAJOBS_API_KEY=... USAJOBS_USER_AGENT=you@example.com watch add --source usajobs --query "registered nurse"

adzuna.terms: free key, daily quota, attribution; excerpts only
adzuna.example: ADZUNA_APP_ID=... ADZUNA_APP_KEY=... watch add --source adzuna --country us --query "electrician"

hn.terms: Firebase API, no limit; the latest Who is hiring thread's comments are the postings

rss.terms: any RSS or Atom feed the publisher offers

email.terms: the board's own job-alert emails (Indeed, Glassdoor, LinkedIn offer them); save them as .eml or .txt into <store>/inbox/email/ and poll reads them

file.terms: a folder of pasted postings (.txt, .md, .html, .json); poll reads new files

indeed.reason: no public job-search API (Publisher API retired); terms forbid bots, scrapers and automating Indeed Apply; Cloudflare and login walls
indeed.alternative: create an Indeed job alert email and add it with --source email; or use Adzuna, which aggregates many of the same postings with a free key

glassdoor.reason: API closed; terms forbid automated access; login wall
glassdoor.alternative: Glassdoor job alert emails with --source email

linkedin.reason: Jobs API is partner-only; the user agreement bans bots and restricts accounts that use them
linkedin.alternative: LinkedIn job alert emails (up to 20 alerts) with --source email; the company's own Greenhouse, Lever or Ashby board when it has one
